title: Browsers: an XLSX Blob in headless Chrome
dataset: 10 columns per row: five numbers, three strings (one unique per row), a Date and a boolean, built before timing; every library gets the same array
method: Each library runs in a fresh browser; the time is the median of three runs after the library has loaded. SheetJS writes with compression: true.
notes: Hypaxel's WebAssembly memory stayed at 2.4 MB in both runs. The browser does not expose the peak JavaScript heap, so memory is not compared across libraries.
Download sizes, gzipped: Hypaxel 171 KB of WebAssembly plus about 7 KB of minified JavaScript; SheetJS xlsx.full.min.js 335 KB (xlsx.mini.min.js 86 KB); ExcelJS exceljs.min.js 256 KB.
reproduce:
npm run bench:browser                        # 100,000 rows; needs Chrome (or set CHROME_PATH)
node benchmarks/browser/run.mjs 300000
